title: [FE] UI/UX QA Fixes: Approvals Widget & Approvals Journey (spacing and alignment items A to G)
walkthroughSteps: BMPCC-17678 is a UI/UX QA list (items A to G): spacing, capitalisation, header bar, alignment and currency fixes on the Approvals widget and Approvals journey. Each AC below is one Jira item.
Navigate to /dashboard and look at the Recent approval requests widget (items A, B, C)
The Approvals journey header and Indemnity/Expenses tables (items D, E, F) are not in the prototype
Not from BMPCC-17678: /approvals row menu below has no Jira source in this ticket

walkthroughSteps.title: Not from BMPCC-17678: Approvals journey
walkthroughSteps.body: Each pending request has an actions menu with Approve, Reject, and View details.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens the row's action menu: Approve/Reject drive the request's status, View details opens the full request.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Approvals widget: spacing above the title matches Figma
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira item A: *Spacing above "Recent Approval Requests" title matches Figma reference.*

**What the screen does:** the dashboard has the *Recent approval requests* widget. Its header spacing comes from the shared widget shell and has not been checked against the Figma node in this ticket. Marked `partial`.

setup.description: Uses the seeded dashboard and approvals data: no override needed

expectedUI.description: Approvals widget: spacing above the title matches Figma

howToTest.trigger: Open the dashboard, look at the Recent approval requests widget
howToTest.expectedResult: Header spacing (not yet checked against Figma)

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Approvals widget: gap between Reserves/Payments tabs and the table is 32px
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira item B: *Gap between tabs and table below is reduced to 32px, applied consistently across all widgets with this spacing pattern.*

**What the screen does:** the gap under the tabs is a small 8px spacer (`portfolio-tabs-spacer` in `_widget-shell.scss`), not 32px. Marked `partial`.

setup.description: Uses the seeded dashboard and approvals data: no override needed

preconditions.text: Reserves / Payments tabs above the table

expectedUI.description: Approvals widget: gap between Reserves/Payments tabs and the table is 32px
visualCues: Reserves / Payments tabs above the table

howToTest.trigger: Look at the gap under the Reserves / Payments tabs

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Approvals widget: Line of Business text is capitalised the same as in the approvals journey
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira item C: *Text (e.g. "Property") is capitalized consistently with how it appears in the approvals journey itself.*

**What the screen does:** the Line of Business column reads *Property* in the widget and on `/approvals`.

setup.description: Uses the seeded dashboard and approvals data: no override needed

expectedUI.description: Approvals widget: Line of Business text is capitalised the same as in the approvals journey

howToTest.trigger: Look at the Line of Business column

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Approvals journey header: the extra grey bar above the breadcrumb bar is removed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira item D: *The extra grey bar above the breadcrumb bar is removed; only the bar holding the breadcrumbs remains.*

**What the screen does:** the prototype has no approvals journey with this header. `/approvals` is a list page. Marked `todo`.

preconditions.text: No approvals journey header in the prototype

expectedUI.description: Approvals journey header: the extra grey bar above the breadcrumb bar is removed
visualCues: No approvals journey header in the prototype

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Financial Summary table: no policy currency in the header column
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira item G: *Remove policy currency in the header column of the Financial Summary table.*

**What the screen does:** the Financial summary table on Financial overview has headers *Movement type, Outstanding reserves, Completed payments, Pending payment, Recoveries, Incurred* with no policy currency.
